changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwcurrentmedication AS SELECT cm.id, cm.patient_id, cm.active_ingredient_id, cm.start_date, cm.created_by, cm.created_date, cm.last_modified_by, cm.last_modified_date, cm.status, cm.cancelled_by, cm.cancelled_date, cm.cancellation_reason, cm.dosage, cm.unit, cm.frequency FROM public.current_medication cm;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwcurrentmedication TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwcurrentmedication FROM report_user;
